summary: Iteration 40: frontend-only retest of the iteration_39 HIGH bug and the responsive tiers (preview host, live backend; no data created, no messages sent). Fixed: at 700x900 'concierge-sheet' is now at x=110 with w=480 and its overlay ancestors are also 110/480. 'meter-install-modal' is at x=110 with w=480, and its mi-* controls sit inside the column (x 126 to 574). STILL BROKEN: at 700px the business switcher sheet (Sites tab 'sites-business-chip') spans the full 700px. 'biz-option-all' is at x=16 with w=668. The cause is that business-switcher-chip.tsx uses an RN <Modal>, not <Portal>, so the Portal outlet inset doesn't apply to it, and its sheet style has no phone cap or useDesktopSheet. All other checks pass. Splash at 700px: 'web-app-shell' has clientWidth 480 (border 0, boxShadow outline), the scroller is 480/1440, and Next moves scrollLeft exactly 0 to 480 to 960 with no clipping. At 900px the shell is 820px at x=40. 'dashboard-tablet-grid' is a row with 2 columns of 387px, plus a full-width 788px child. Concierge is a centred 600px dialog at x=150. At 390x844 the shell is 390 with no tablet grid, and the concierge bottom sheet is x=0, w=390. At 1440x900 desktop-sidebar (248) and desktop-topbar render, there is no web-app-shell, and concierge is a centred 600px dialog at x=420. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

ui_bugs.issue: At 700x900 the 'Switch business' bottom sheet still spans the full viewport (option rows x=16, w=668) instead of the 480 column. It is an RN <Modal>, so the PortalOutlet inset fix does not cover it, and styles.sheet has no maxWidth. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/business-switcher-chip.tsx:103-113

action_items: MEDIUM: Cap the business-switcher mobile sheet to the 480 column on the web phone tier. Apply the useDesktopSheet() styles, as profile.tsx, site-actions-sheet.tsx, add-business-modal.tsx, select-field.tsx and onboarding/[token].tsx already do. Another option: switch to <Portal>. Leave native untouched. Reference: src/components/business-switcher-chip.tsx:103-105
critical_code_review_comments: portal.tsx: the outlet inset is computed with (width - frameW)/2 only on the phone tier, which is correct. On tablet and desktop the inset is 0 and the dialogs centre themselves. Native is unaffected because useWebTier returns 'native'.
The RN <Modal> users other than business-switcher-chip already use useDesktopSheet, so business-switcher-chip.tsx is the only remaining uncapped sheet.
desktop-frame.tsx: the phone and tablet columns use boxShadow '0 0 0 1px', so inner width now equals useFrameWidth (480/820). This resolves the iteration_39 2px clipping.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (9/10 checks pass; business switcher still full width at 700px)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: signin-email-input / signin-password-input / signin-submit-button (retry once). Scope 'talk-to-human' with [data-testid=dashboard-scroll]. Switcher: go to /sites and tap sites-business-chip, then check the biz-option-all box. Expected at 700px: x=126, w=448.
rca_of_issue: Business switcher: the web phone-tier fix was added to PortalOutlet, but BusinessSwitcherChip renders its mobile sheet in a react-native <Modal>, which mounts at the document root outside both the shell and the Portal outlet. Its styles.backdrop/styles.sheet have no maxWidth, so it fills the viewport. Repro: 700x900, log in, go to /sites, tap 'Switch'.
